explore.title: Explore
explore.lead: Find members, pages and communities across the whole network.
explore.membersBody: Search among the members who chose to appear in the directory. Contact goes through messaging.
explore.servicesBody: Hairdressing, translation, photography, help settling in: find a diaspora skill near you.
explore.countriesLead: Each hub brings together a country's news, events, associations and companies.
explore.countriesEmptyBody: A country opens with two relay associations and one moderator. Your country's hub can already be read.
explore.countriesErrorTitle: The list of countries is unavailable.
explore.countriesErrorBody: Check your connection and reload the page to try again.
explore.mutualAidBody: Ask a practical question or offer your help, and find volunteer missions from associations.
explore.arrivalKitBody: Paperwork, housing, health, transport: dated, sourced and reviewed resources, city by city.
explore.mentoringBody: Volunteer members share their experience of studying, working or settling in.
explore.jobsBody: Job offers published by diaspora companies and associations, and the talents who chose to be visible.
